items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: the camp director, a guy named Jeff Antoniuk, now he’s got Peter Erskine I think, Bob Mintzer, I don’t know he’s got all these like stars chiming in for a session

ctx.x: Well I, you’ve also answered sort of my last question and that is during these last couple of months have you observed positive and negative aspects of people, and I appreciate that positive description that you just offered.

Yeah. Well you see, like I’m amazed by my friends and bandmates and other friends and some are like so, so positive. Like within one day, like my last job was March 10. I was in Cedar Rapids, Iowa at Coe College. I was on a little solo tour, like I was in Nebraska at the Nebraska Band Master’s Association. And I spent four days in Iowa and I went from, actually my trio was in Florida with Maurice Hines just before that. It was going great. I get home and then all you see, all your gigs like cancel, and it’s…
